name: Hoia-Baciu Forest
description: An oak forest west of Cluj-Napoca in Transylvania, Romania, internationally known as a hotspot of paranormal claims — UFO sightings, ghost reports, missing-person legends, and an alleged 'dead zone' clearing — and the subject of paranormal-tourism interest.
origin: A specific location: an oak forest of approximately 250–295 hectares on the western outskirts of Cluj-Napoca, Cluj County, Transylvania, Romania.
